examples.detection_method: Continuous monitoring of software update integrity by validating code signatures against vendor's trusted certificates. Use of SBOM to detect unexpected new components (e.g., malicious_module). Endpoint monitoring for suspicious process creations involving DLL execution from vendor folders. Network monitoring and DNS logging to detect unknown or anomalous outbound connections to newly seen C2 domains. Registry and file system integrity checks to detect unauthorized changes.
